name: Host, administration and observability
native_lifecycle: Start/configure/observe the real Host, authorize its management operations and run the local Host/Agent integration journey; retain protected diagnostics and honest server/plugin/license mappings.

name: Identity, accounts and access
native_lifecycle: First login through ordinary/installation identity, users/groups/roles/current scoped rights, credential issue/revoke and denied cross-project access with unchanged cookies/tokens.

name: Projects and versioned C# catalog
rest_scope: /projects; /buildTypes; /versionedSettings; parameters/templates/inheritance; project configuration secret references (bytes remain private)
native_lifecycle: Create/edit/copy/move/read/reset a complete catalog through the same managed C#/Git activation path, with inherited/effective values, validation and immutable revision provenance.

name: VCS, changes and source checkout
native_lifecycle: Define a source root, observe branches/changes, select immutable revisions and checkout rules and execute the real source Compile with exact source provenance.

name: Agent fleet, pools and compatibility
native_lifecycle: Enroll/observe/manage real Agents, independent status axes, facts/requirements/compatibility reasons, pool/run policy and safe workload ownership; preserve upgrades and independent AgentExplorer behavior.

name: Provider and cloud capacity
rest_scope: /cloud/instances; provider/cloud profile operations from required inputs
native_lifecycle: Implement the required referenced capacity start/stop/ownership lifecycle and Agent linkage after exact mapping; no fake cloud success or speculative full hypervisor platform.

name: Queue, run lifecycle and build history
native_lifecycle: Submit/queue/assign/acknowledge/run/cancel/finish/recover a real run with stable identity, settings freeze, separate state/outcome, approval/retry semantics and truthful historical metadata.

name: Steps, runners, features and execution parameters
native_lifecycle: Execute the required ordered steps/runners/features with resolved parameters, exit/cancel behavior, produced output and effects; a property bag accepted over REST is not an implemented runner.

name: Build chains and dependency selection
native_lifecycle: Resolve/reuse/rebuild and execute a dependency DAG with exact upstream runs/artifact inputs, ordering, failure propagation and required affinity.

name: Triggers and release coordination
native_lifecycle: Drive VCS/finish/schedule triggers, locks/counters and single publisher ownership through restart and coexistence, producing the intended actual runs once under the reference rules.

name: Build logs and service messages
rest_scope: /builds/.../log; non-REST build log download/tail paths; service messages
native_lifecycle: Retain/read/tail/download ordered bounded build output with restart/reconnect/gap/redaction semantics and safely parse service messages into the real owning services.

name: Tests, problems, triage and statistics
native_lifecycle: Ingest actual TRX/JUnit/service-message evidence and browse stable test/problem identities, per-run occurrences, rich history/triage/statistics with raw provenance and honest partial/missing states.

name: Artifacts, byte storage and retention
native_lifecycle: Publish/list/download exact artifact bytes/trees/archives/ranges, retain pins/references and apply cleanup/retention safely across runs, results and imports.

name: Deployments and publication
native_lifecycle: Record/manage required deployment environments/instances/history and real publication/VCS-label outcomes with current rights and single ownership; no successful metadata stub standing in for deployment.

name: Import, coexistence and recovery
rest_scope: /server/backup; native import/diff-import/restore; imported graph through all related APIs
native_lifecycle: Import retained runs/tests/logs/artifacts, repeat/resume explicit diff choices, preserve source-independent graph/bytes, rehearse coexistence/final delta and prove fresh restore.

name: REST protocol and conformance foundation
native_lifecycle: Provide shared protocol parsing/projection, independent reference-backed contract evidence and cheap deterministic conformance; no second domain authority. P0 baseline is not product API-complete.
